photos_used: assets/hero.jpg (client receiving a facial treatment, serene expression, window light)
assets/gal-massage.jpg (hands performing a lymphatic drainage / body contouring massage)
assets/logo.jpg (official Palms Aesthetics gold palm-tree/woman logo, used as site favicon and nav/footer mark)
photos_rejected: Google photo of a facial-treatment-menu Canva graphic with Spanish text overlay ('Mis Servicios') and 'Genesis Martinez Aesthetics' branding: used only as a data source for service names, not placed in the site gallery (text-over-photo rule).
Second Canva-style graphic ('Tratamientos faciales') with full Spanish text overlay: same treatment, data source only.

Before/after body-contouring photo with a 'Genesis Martinez Aesthetics' watermark centered on the thigh: not used, watermark cannot be cropped out without losing the body and the underwear-only framing was judged too intimate for a public cold-outreach demo.

Two photos of a client wearing a post-op compression garment with 'Genesis Martinez Aesthetics' watermark (one centered on the back, one corner watermark): not used for the same reasons (watermark placement and overly intimate framing even after cropping tests).

Facial-treatment photo with the client's eyes closed mid-treatment: excluded from the gallery per curation rule, but used as the hero image instead since a relaxed, eyes-closed facial shot is normal and expected imagery for this niche outside the gallery grid.
photo_curation_note: 12 photo URLs were listed in the Maps data; 2 were exact duplicates (10 unique files). Several uploads were the business' own Canva-style marketing graphics or watermarked body photos rather than candid studio photography. After curation, 4 real photos plus the official logo were used across hero, experience, gallery and featured-service sections; duplicate-use of the same 4 photos across sections (e.g. hero image also appears in the gallery grid) was accepted given the limited real photo set, per the 'fewer sections, no bad filler' rule.

reviewSamples.author: Gisselle Fernandez
reviewSamples.text: I had an excellent experience with my massage therapy session. The massage therapist was very professional, attentive, and knowledgeable. The massage really helped relieve muscle tension and left me feeling relaxed and well.

reviewSamples.author: Elizabeth Santamaria
reviewSamples.text: I had a wonderful experience with Genesis Martinez at Palmas Aesthetics! I completed a package of wood therapy and lymphatic drainage massages, and I'm very happy with the positive results.

reviewSamples.author: Mariana Boada
reviewSamples.text: I absolutely love this place! The body contouring massages have been such a great addition to my journey, and I've noticed a difference in my results. The team is amazing, and I couldn't recommend them enough!

reviewSamples.author: Ley Orozco
reviewSamples.text: I want to recommend this place 10/10 for been professional, friendly, supportive, knowledgeable on my post recovery. The atmosphere very peaceful, the owner Genesis very sweet and passionate for what she does. Each visit I left happy.

reviewSamples.author: Marilyn Diaz
reviewSamples.text: I'm so grateful for everything they did for me. I can see and feel the difference in my body, and I highly recommend Genesis Martinez aesthetics to anyone looking for professional post-op care and body contouring.
